mapper.sql: id, task_no, user_id, session_id, task_type, model_id, model_name, task_status, input_type, input_summary, input_payload, attachment_id, result_summary, result_payload, error_message, record_id, duration_ms, confirmed_at, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task (task_no, user_id, session_id, task_type, model_id, model_name, task_status, input_type, input_summary, input_payload, attachment_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskType}, #{modelId}, #{modelName}, #{taskStatus}, #{inputType}, #{inputSummary}, #{inputPayload}, #{attachmentId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET task_status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND task_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE agent_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', start_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND task_status = 'CONFIRMED'

UPDATE agent_task SET task_status = 'SUCCESS', result_summary = #{resultSummary}, result_payload = #{resultPayload}, record_id = #{recordId}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_task SET task_status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PENDING'
